# homeassistant_entity_registry (Data Source)

Lists the entries of the entity registry that match every filter that is set (`config/entity_registry/list`). Without filters, it lists every entry. Unlike `homeassistant_entities`, it includes disabled entities, and it has no state or attributes. Filters compare exactly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The primary entities of every device from one read: skip config and diagnostic entities, and
# hidden or disabled ones. A device often has several, e.g. a light with its power and energy
# sensors, so each device maps to a list.
data "homeassistant_entity_registry" "all" {}

locals {
  primary_entities = {
    for e in data.homeassistant_entity_registry.all.entities :
    e.device_id => e.entity_id... if e.device_id != null && e.entity_category == null
    && e.hidden_by == null && e.disabled_by == null
  }
}

output "primary_entities_by_device" {
  value = local.primary_entities
}

# The update entities of HACS, including disabled ones, e.g. to disable them all with
# homeassistant_entity_settings and find them again on the next plan.
data "homeassistant_entity_registry" "hacs_updates" {
  domain   = "update"
  platform = "hacs"
}

output "hacs_update_entities" {
  value = { for e in data.homeassistant_entity_registry.hacs_updates.entities : e.entity_id => e.disabled_by }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Only entities of the device with this ID.
- `domain` (String) Only entities of this domain, e.g. `light`.
- `entity_category` (String) Only entities of this category: `config` or `diagnostic`.
- `platform` (String) Only entities of this integration, e.g. `mqtt`.

### Read-Only

- `entities` (Attributes List) The matching entries, sorted by `entity_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))

<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) ID of the entity's device; null if it belongs to none.
- `disabled_by` (String) Who disabled the entity, e.g. `user` or `integration`; null if it is enabled.
- `entity_category` (String) `config` or `diagnostic`; null for a primary entity.
- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID.
- `hidden_by` (String) Who hid the entity, e.g. `user` or `integration`; null if it is visible.
- `id` (String) Registry ID. Unlike the entity ID, a rename does not change it.
- `platform` (String) Integration that provides the entity, e.g. `mqtt`.
- `unique_id` (String) ID the integration gave the entity, unique within the integration.
